body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy or unattended object within 5 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, move the enemy 2 units horizontally along a clear path and deal 1 Force Damage. An unattended light object instead moves 3 units without opposition.

surges.html: On a hit, suppress the target's ordinary benefit from the cover it just left until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Projection
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, leave a kinetic brace in the destination until the start of your next turn: its occupant resists the next 2 units of forced movement; you may choose not to brace an enemy.
